$comment: Planned GLB model targets. Dimensions in mm. Colour values are sampled from supplier product photography and are NOT authoritative - see README.md, the within-object lighting range exceeds the between-family differences.

colours.$comment: Working values, accepted as good enough. Real boxes vary batch to batch and exact colour matching is not a requirement. glTF baseColorFactor is linear, so use the linear figures, not the sampled sRGB hex.

alc_blue.note: Shares the eurobox blue. The three sampled hex values are the same plastic under different lighting, so they set a range rather than a value; exact match is not required for these models.

steel_grey.note: generic galvanised/powder-coated grey, not sampled from the product
